title: Alloy heat-treatment coupon strength vs 420 MPa spec
what: T6 mean UTS (~452 MPa), margin above 420 MPa spec (~32 MPa), or T6 vs T6-aged gap

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: T6 averages 451.0 MPa (+31.0 MPa above the 420 MPa spec) and passes 8/8 coupons.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; T6 sits well above the 420 MPa threshold across all 8 replicate coupons.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Although T6-aged averages 435.1 MPa (above 420), 2 of its 8 individual coupons fail the 420 MPa spec.
